member.name: M:robot_controller_api.Controllers.MapsController.AddMap(robot_controller_api.Models.Map)
member.param: The map details from the HTTP request body.
member.remarks:
Sample request:
POST /api/maps { "name": "Moon Base Map", "description": "A square map for robot movement testing", "rows": 5, "columns": 5 }

If the request body is null, the name is missing, or rows/columns are invalid.
